title: Query-Focused Video Summarization: Dataset, Evaluation, and A Memory Network Based Approach
encoders: 70 SentiBank detector scores plus six contextual correlation features
sampling: Eight frames per 5-second shot; ten shots per sequential segment
architecture: Query attends to frames through a memory network; resulting shot embeddings parameterize the sequential DPP.
objective: Section 4.3: maximize training-summary log likelihood; SGD learns embeddings, validation selects epochs and learning rate.
training_data: QFVS query-summary annotation layer on UTE
test_data: Four UTE source videos with QFVS references
split: Four rounds: two training, one validation and one test video
budget: Main experiment unconstrained; separate 10/20-shot annotations reserved for future work
postprocessing: Sequential shot-subset selection using learned DPP
code_status: Paper links dataset/evaluation release at www.aidean-sharghi.com/cvpr2017; endpoint failed fetch
features: Feature definition in paper; released tensors Not independently verified
reproducibility: Primary paper read; no artifact download or execution.
limitations: Only four source videos; concept-based F1 has a different meaning from temporal-overlap F1.

title: Video Co-summarization: Video Summarization by Visual Co-occurrence
encoders: CENTRIST, Dense-SIFT and HSV moments; concatenate and PCA-reduce to 400-D
sampling: Provided shot boundaries; exact frame sampling Not independently verified
architecture: Find mutually similar shot groups across topic-related videos using a bipartite graph.
objective: Section 3.4, Eq. 4: maximize weighted co-occurrence minus L1 sparsity penalties under pairwise similarity constraints; relaxed alternating updates.
training_data: No human-summary training labels; joint optimization on the input video group
test_data: CoSum: 51 video instances in ten groups; additional CMU-Mocap experiment
split: Collection-level unsupervised setting; no canonical training/test partition
budget: Evaluate top five and top fifteen shots
postprocessing: Rank shots by co-occurrence quality; select highest-ranked shots
code_status: Official dataset/annotation and shot-index release; full algorithm implementation not independently verified
features: Paper describes handcrafted descriptors; ready-made tensor release not found in inspected repository
reproducibility: Paper and official data README inspected; video URLs were not downloaded.
limitations: Repeated visual content is a relevance proxy; source groups influence the summary. Input-group access must be recorded.

title: SummScreen: A Dataset for Abstractive Screenplay Summarization
encoders: Longformer encoder for neural baseline; text only
sampling: Transcript lines terminated by special EOS tokens; no video frames
architecture: Decoder attends to line-ending encoder vectors; paper also benchmarks nearest-neighbor and hybrid variants.
objective: Supervised transcript-to-recap learning; precise loss formula Not independently verified
test_data: Separate FD and TMS test sets
budget: Text output, no temporal duration budget
postprocessing: Author repository supplies beam-search generation script; record selected beam size
code_status: Official training/generation scripts and tokenized/untokenized data links inspected
features: Tokenized text with BPE files; no raw video or visual feature archive
reproducibility: Paper and README read; scripts not run, checkpoints not verified. Untokenized extra instances require split filename matching.
limitations: Transcript dataset, not native video-summary supervision. Community recaps require factuality checks beyond lexical overlap.
tasks: Abstractive transcript summarization; adjacent to video summarization

title: Hierarchical3D Adapters for Long Video-to-text Summarization
sampling: Modalities aligned and mean-pooled to utterances; 60 selected utterances at inference
architecture: Frozen textual summarizer augmented with trainable multimodal projection and hierarchical adapters.
fusion: Utterance-level multimodal tokens and textual token representations
objective: Summary-token negative log likelihood plus encoder MLM during first 1500 steps (Section 4.3, Eqs. 2–3). Optional learned selector uses BCE.
training_data: SummScreen3D training episode/recap pairs; pretrained textual summarizer
split: 3983 training episodes (calculated), 296 validation, 296 test; 5199 training episode-summary pairs
budget: BART input context: 60 utterances; no 15% visual-summary budget
postprocessing: Original utterance order; beam size 5 and trigram blocking
code_status: Official transcripts, captions, summaries, split IDs and downloader inspected; complete adapter training implementation not independently verified
framework: Python downloader; training framework/version Not independently verified
features: Paper specifies CLIP/SlowFast/Sentence-BERT/YAMNet; no ready-made feature archive verified
reproducibility: Primary paper and author repository read; no video download, feature extraction or model run.
limitations: Shared episodes with SummScreen-TMS; content selection discards context before decoding. Lexical overlap alone does not establish factuality.
